node.title: L1 m=4, h=3 colored cyclic-code equivalence
node.statement: On each of the four official rows n=4(p+1), exact split-value degree h=3 is equivalent to a word with coefficients in {0,1,omega,omega^2}, each nonzero color occurring p times, such that both the word and its coefficientwise square lie in the explicit Mersenne cyclic code. Here omega is a prime-field cube root because p=1 mod 3. The coefficientwise cube is the union indicator and has exactly p+4 zero positions. This is an exact two-Schur-section reduction, not an emptiness theorem, component count, nonembedded h=2 classification, or L1 bound.
